title: Research: reverse F2 transfers attain sharp six-pass connector
body:
## Result

Adding the reverse F2 root transfer `D:z1+=z0` lowers the exact universal five-source/31-output connector threshold from PR1615's one-way **8 transfers to 6**, at exactly two calls per B and A operator. The new complete word has **78 root calls: 10 B + 62 A + 3 C + 3 D**.

The witness uses the restoring `(CD)^3` loop in GL(2,F2); four sources change physical ports between their paired calls. This answers PR1615's explicit reverse-transfer open question rather than extending the old one-way census.

## Evidence

- Written moving-frame proof: paired source injections have equal normalized columns; paired readers have equal dirt rows. Three source directions cannot supply mask31; one direction reduces to the credited old945-pairing obstruction. The two-direction relaxation leaves175 word/partition pairs.
- Four-transfer loops have representatives CCCC/CCDD up to justified cyclic/root symmetry. Two independently structured exact engines agree on all histograms across2,102,100 reduced candidates, maximum31/32. Odd counts fail dirt parity; shorter even words pad to4. Thus6 is sharp.
- Explicit 78-call certificate, all31 readout pairs, complete180-factor+6-transfer expansion, arbitrary-dirty free noncommutative replay,522 dense basis/mixed-state cases and162 semantic mutation controls.
- Source-bound package with complete independent chooser output, task/budget, exact predecessor pins and registered Python3.12 replay.

## Scope and complete price

This is an abstract incidence-minimal F2 connector result, **not a new physical supplier or kappa**. Every child port, both transfer directions, scratch restoration and parent routing/admission/dispatch remain charged. Under equal complete child/transfer prices the favorable condition against the old74-query single-root repair is `6*sigma + Delta H < 2*c`. Unit root-call prices alone do not improve that repair.
